body:
Run record for the re-run #23950 asks for, after its six stale clauses were re-pointed. Runner: an `os-dev` subagent dispatched by the `domain:devx` seat 2 PM (session `session_016PVjjuVPte5XEJvaQx1E4t`). Protocol: `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` + `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`. Executed sequentially (no subagent tool in this runner).

## Environment fingerprint

- framework: `fb82f9b180bcc6af04ce8d36153fd52d2eb6845c`, the tip of branch `claude/issue-23950-checklist-stale-clauses` at run time. Its product tree is `origin/main` `022c6e799`; the branch adds `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` only. Built with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build` (75/75 tasks green).
- `.objectui-sha`: `daeb77fc84dd824e74c95b87cdede85afdb248e7` (this item drives no console).
- host: `os start -p 47311 -d file:(run dir)/ai/data.db` from `examples/app-showcase`, with `OS_PORT=47311`. The personas were provisioned first on `os dev --ui --seed-admin` over the same port and DB, and that server was stopped before the stdio legs.
- personas: the seeded admin; a contributor-bound member and a client_liaison-bound member, each minted by invite + sign-up and placed through `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position`; one `osk_` key each through `POST /api/v1/keys`. The contributor owns one invoice of its own (`POST /api/v1/data/showcase_invoice`).
- stdio client: line-delimited JSON-RPC that writes nothing until the `principal-bound` line is in the log (see the note under the verdicts).
- timestamps: 2026-10-16, 16:21Z to 16:26Z.

## Scope

Selector `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed` resolves to 1 runnable item: `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed` at revision 5, P0, surface cli. Revision 5 is the revision #23950's branch carries. The item text was read at the branch head `c4bf2ba4e`. After the run, revision 5's clause 1 and clause 6 dropped their quotation of the revocation message's wording. That edit unpins wording only; the code, status and no-row evidence below is what both clauses score.

Tier 1 pin (RUNNER rule 6): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/__tests__/plugin.test.ts`: 1 file, 17 passed. The pin covers the keyless and unknown-key refusals and the stdio-off boot. It does not cover the per-call revocation or the lifecycle arm of the up-front admission, so those were driven by hand.

## Derived item verdict

`ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed` r5: **pass** (8 of 8 clauses).

Fixture notes, not defects of this item:
- `showcase_invoice` has no `number` field; its invoice number is `name`, and a create carrying `number` is refused 400 INVALID_FIELD.
- An MCP client that writes `initialize` the moment it spawns `os start` gets a boot that never loaded the config. `os start` spawns `serve` with stdio inherited and no positional `config` argument, and the CLI's argument parser reads a pending stdin line as that argument. The boot then says `No objectstack.config.ts found — booting from artifact (default host)…`, the showcase boot exits 1, and the client's `initialize` is never answered. With `objectstack.config.ts` passed explicitly to `serve` and the same early write, the config loads. This run's client waited for the `principal-bound` line before writing, so no verdict above is affected. The defect is handed to the dispatching seat for its own card.

Timing: the build was shared across this re-run's five records (`pnpm build` 8m19s under the verify lock). This item took about 5 minutes: 1 minute of provisioning boot and 4 minutes of legs.

Checklist-accuracy findings, if any, close out on the wave anchor #23878; nothing is extracted from this record by its runner (the early-write defect above goes to the dispatching seat).
